Flow Analytics — Vanna, Charm & Put Skew

March 19, 2026
VANNA & CHARM EXPOSURE
Vanna: dDelta/dSigma — when vol changes, dealers re-hedge delta mechanically. Positive vanna = vol compression drives equity buying. Charm: dDelta/dT — daily delta decay creates intraday mechanical flows even without price movement. Strongest near OPEX.
PUT/CALL OI RATIO
Put/Call Ratio: Values above 1.5 signal heavy defensive hedging by institutions. Put walls represent strikes with heavy short-put dealer exposure — dealer delta selling below these levels can accelerate declines.
